subject.title: [Feature]: Batch WhatsApp messages by messageTimestamp instead of receive time

question: Should WhatsApp timestamp coalescing be default behavior, an opt-in WhatsApp config, or deferred under broader channel batching policy?
rationale: The code path is clear, but the choice affects user-visible latency, turn grouping, and the public config contract for an integration-specific delivery quirk.

options.title: Add opt-in WhatsApp coalescing
options.body: Introduce a narrowly scoped WhatsApp timestamp coalescing option with focused tests and no default behavior change.

options.title: Make coalescing default
options.body: Treat same-server-timestamp WhatsApp text messages as one turn by default, accepting an upgrade-sensitive change in turn boundaries.

options.title: Defer to broader batching policy
options.body: Keep this issue open until per-group debounce, media batching, and timestamp coalescing are resolved as one channel batching design.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in WhatsApp coalescing
recommendation.body: Introduce a narrowly scoped WhatsApp timestamp coalescing option with focused tests and no default behavior change.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans shared debounce policy, WhatsApp config compatibility, and docs, and steipete has both prior review context and adjacent merge history.
